name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.34.1

🔵 A sprint field per role — a team of several roles living in one project can now keep its sprints in different issue fields. Settings gained a “Sprint field” column in the roles table; leave it empty and the role uses the shared field, so projects with a single field see no change. The sprint form adapts on its own: one picker while every participating role shares a field, a row per role the moment they differ.

🔵 Write the sprint into YouTrack issues — a new switch, off by default. When on, confirming a role composition sets the chosen sprint value on every active issue of that composition, under your own permissions, in batches, with a per-issue report. The value is only ever set, never cleared — someone may have set it by hand before the planner touched it. Multi-value fields are no longer offered as sprint fields, and a previously saved one is refused before any write.

🔵 A refresh button that says what it does — “Refresh from task” told you neither what it pulls nor where from. It is now “Refresh issue data from YouTrack” in every interface language, and it is styled as a primary action.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
